name: forecasting_benchmarks
description: A collection of time-series forecasting datasets intended to evaluate forecasting models across multiple domains and horizons. It provides standardized splits and evaluation setups so researchers can compare forecasting algorithms on common tasks. The benchmark focuses on numeric sequence prediction rather than language or vision.
evaluation_method: RMSE (root mean squared error) / MAE commonly reported
reputation: Modestly used by time-series researchers as a convenient aggregation of forecasting tasks on Hugging Face, but not a dominant community standard.
